gageRoue.bisou1: A kiss on the neck, with no warning.
gageRoue.bisou2: A ten-second kiss, timed by the other one.
gageRoue.bisou3: Kiss your partner's hand like it is another century.
gageRoue.bisou4: A kiss on the forehead, then look them in the eye.
gageRoue.bisou5: Your partner picks where the kiss goes, no arguing.
gageRoue.bisou6: A welcome-home kiss as if you had not seen each other for a month.
gageRoue.bisou7: Three little kisses in a row, in three different places.
gageRoue.bisou8: An eskimo kiss, nose to nose, for five seconds.
gageRoue.bisou9: A kiss on the shoulder, without saying a word.
gageRoue.bisou10: Recreate your very first kiss, as well as you remember it.
gageRoue.massage1: Two minutes of shoulder massage, in silence.
gageRoue.massage2: Massage your partner's hands, finger by finger.
gageRoue.massage3: A scalp massage, one minute on the clock.
gageRoue.massage4: Massage your partner's feet for two minutes.
gageRoue.massage5: Your partner says where it hurts, you take care of that spot.
gageRoue.massage6: One minute of neck massage, eyes closed for whoever receives it.
gageRoue.massage7: Draw letters on their back as you massage, they guess the word.
gageRoue.massage8: A hug lasting at least thirty seconds, without moving.
gageRoue.massage9: Massage their temples until they let out a proper sigh.
gageRoue.massage10: Two minutes of massage, wherever the other one points.
gageRoue.show1: Sing the chorus of a love song, standing up.
gageRoue.show2: Invent an advertising slogan for your relationship and deliver it.
gageRoue.show3: Dance for thirty seconds with no music, and mean it.
gageRoue.show4: Do an impression of your partner in a bad mood.
gageRoue.show5: Recite the alphabet in a TV presenter voice.
gageRoue.show6: Make an over-the-top declaration of love, romantic film style.
gageRoue.show7: Sing your next sentence instead of saying it, until the next spin.
gageRoue.show8: Act out how you first met, playing both parts.
gageRoue.show9: Improvise an eight-second rap about your partner.
gageRoue.show10: Give an acceptance speech as if your relationship had won an award.
gageRoue.aveu1: Say one thing you have never dared to ask for.
gageRoue.aveu2: Tell them the moment you knew this was serious.
gageRoue.aveu3: Own up to a small silly thing you never told them.
gageRoue.aveu4: Say what you noticed first, physically, about your partner.
gageRoue.aveu5: Tell them about a time you were jealous and kept quiet.
gageRoue.aveu6: Name one thing your partner does that reassures you.
gageRoue.aveu7: Admit one of their habits that gets on your nerves, kindly.
gageRoue.aveu8: Share the nicest compliment anyone has paid your relationship.
gageRoue.aveu9: Say what you wish you were asked more often.
gageRoue.aveu10: Tell them about a moment you were afraid of losing them.
gageRoue.grimace1: Pull the ugliest face you can and hold it for five seconds.
gageRoue.grimace2: Speak in an accent of your choice until the next spin.
gageRoue.grimace3: Impersonate an animal, the other one has to guess which.
gageRoue.grimace4: Walk to the door and back like a runway model.
gageRoue.grimace5: Make your partner laugh in under thirty seconds, by any means.
gageRoue.grimace6: Put on one piece of clothing inside out and keep it for three spins.
gageRoue.grimace7: Answer only yes or no for the next two spins.
gageRoue.grimace8: Play a waiter and take your partner's order.
gageRoue.grimace9: Do an impression of the way your partner laughs.
gageRoue.grimace10: Balance on one foot for twenty seconds.
gageRoue.photo1: Take the ugliest possible selfie, both of you.
gageRoue.photo2: Recreate a photo of the two of you that is at least a year old.
gageRoue.photo3: Photograph your partner as if they were posing for a magazine.
gageRoue.photo4: Take a selfie impersonating two film characters.
gageRoue.photo5: Show the last photo on your phone and tell the story behind it.
gageRoue.photo6: Take a photo together with your eyes closed, keep the first shot.
gageRoue.photo7: Take a selfie pulling exactly the same face.
gageRoue.photo8: Find the oldest photo of the two of you and tell them about that day.
gageRoue.photo9: Take a photo of your two hands, and keep it.
gageRoue.photo10: Take a selfie that has to be a wallpaper for a whole day.
gageRoue.douceur1: Three honest compliments, without repeating a single word.
gageRoue.douceur2: Make your partner something to drink, right now.
gageRoue.douceur3: Write a sweet note on paper and hand it over without reading it out.
gageRoue.douceur4: Say thank you for three things they do without being asked.
gageRoue.douceur5: Describe your partner in a single word, then explain why.
gageRoue.douceur6: Promise one small gesture for tomorrow, and keep it.
gageRoue.douceur7: Look your partner in the eye for thirty seconds, saying nothing.
gageRoue.douceur8: Share a memory of the two of you that you never bring up.
gageRoue.douceur9: Say what you like best about your everyday life, the most ordinary thing.
gageRoue.douceur10: Give a hug and do not let go until the other one says stop.
